# 1. Setup

```{r libraries}
# install.packages(c("REDCapR", "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "lubridate", "writexl"))
library(REDCapR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
```

# 2. Load data from REDCap

```{r tokens}
readRenviron("C:/Users/saehyeun.song/Documents/.Renviron")

uri <- "https://ivirdc.ivi.int/api/"

token_names <- c(
  MLW_COMM  = "SAVAC_MLW_COMM_TOKEN_IVI",
  PGI_COMM  = "SAVAC_PGI_COMM_TOKEN_PID180",
  MRCG_COMM = "SAVAC_MRCG_COMM_TOKEN_IVI"
)

tokens <- Sys.getenv(token_names)
names(tokens) <- names(token_names)

# Stop if any token is missing
missing <- names(tokens)[tokens == ""]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("Missing tokens in .Renviron: ", paste(token_names[missing], collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r load-functions}
# Read records from one project ("raw" or "label")
read_redcap <- function(token, site, raw_or_label = "raw") {
  message("> ", site, " [", raw_or_label, "] loading...")
  res <- REDCapR::redcap_read(
    redcap_uri   = uri,
    token        = token,
    raw_or_label = raw_or_label,
    batch_size   = 500,
    verbose      = FALSE
  )
  if (!res$success) {
    warning(site, " [", raw_or_label, "] failed: ", res$outcome_message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  message("  OK: ", nrow(res$data), " rows / ", ncol(res$data), " cols")
  res$data
}

# Read data dictionary from one project
read_metadata <- function(token, site) {
  message("> ", site, " [metadata] loading...")
  res <- REDCapR::redcap_metadata_read(redcap_uri = uri, token = token, verbose = FALSE)
  if (!res$success) {
    warning(site, " [metadata] failed: ", res$outcome_message)
    return(NULL)
  }
  res$data
}
```

```{r load-data}
dat_raw   <- imap(tokens, read_redcap, raw_or_label = "raw")    # coded values
dat_label <- imap(tokens, read_redcap, raw_or_label = "label")  # choice labels
meta      <- imap(tokens, read_metadata)                         # data dictionaries

mlw_comm_raw  <- dat_raw$MLW_COMM
pgi_comm_raw  <- dat_raw$PGI_COMM
mrcg_comm_raw <- dat_raw$MRCG_COMM

mlw_comm_lab  <- dat_label$MLW_COMM
pgi_comm_lab  <- dat_label$PGI_COMM
mrcg_comm_lab <- dat_label$MRCG_COMM

mlw_comm_meta  <- meta$MLW_COMM
pgi_comm_meta  <- meta$PGI_COMM
mrcg_comm_meta <- meta$MRCG_COMM
```

# 3. Check event names

```{r events}
table(mlw_comm_raw$redcap_event_name)
table(pgi_comm_raw$redcap_event_name)
table(mrcg_comm_raw$redcap_event_name)
```

# 4. Functions

```{r functions}
# Build trigger dataset with baseline (bs_) variables and age
# baseline_event / trigger_event: event names differ by site
make_comm_trigger <- function(df,
                              baseline_event = "baseline_arm_1",
                              trigger_event  = "trigger_arm_1") {

  # Baseline: non-repeating row only (one row per record), bs_ variables only
  bs <- df %>%
    filter(redcap_event_name == baseline_event,
           is.na(redcap_repeat_instrument)) %>%
    select(record_id, starts_with("bs_"))

  # Add age-related variables missing in some sites (filled with NA)
  for (v in c("bs_dob", "bs_ic_dt", "bs_age_year", "bs_age_month", "bs_age_calc")) {
    if (!v %in% names(bs)) bs[[v]] <- NA
  }

  # DOB usable: if bs_dob_known exists (MRCG), only when bs_dob_known == 1
  bs$dob_ok <- if ("bs_dob_known" %in% names(bs)) bs$bs_dob_known %in% 1 else TRUE

  bs <- bs %>%
    mutate(
      # as.character() first so all-NA logical columns convert safely
      bs_dob   = as.Date(as.character(bs_dob)),
      bs_ic_dt = as.Date(as.character(bs_ic_dt)),

      # Age at informed consent from DOB
      age_dob = if_else(dob_ok,
                        time_length(interval(bs_dob, bs_ic_dt), "year"),
                        NA_real_),

      # REDCap-calculated age
      age_calc = as.numeric(bs_age_calc),

      # Reported age (years + months)
      age_reported = if_else(
        is.na(bs_age_year),
        NA_real_,
        as.numeric(bs_age_year) + coalesce(as.numeric(bs_age_month), 0) / 12
      ),

      # Final age: DOB first, then REDCap-calculated age, then reported
      age_exact  = coalesce(age_dob, age_calc, age_reported),
      age_years  = round(age_exact, 1),
      age_source = case_when(
        !is.na(age_dob)      ~ "dob",
        !is.na(age_calc)     ~ "calc",
        !is.na(age_reported) ~ "reported",
        TRUE                 ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-dob_ok)

  # Trigger: drop empty bs_ columns, then attach baseline info
  df %>%
    filter(redcap_event_name == trigger_event) %>%
    select(-starts_with("bs_")) %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x)))) %>%          # drop columns empty in trigger rows
    mutate(record_id = as.character(record_id)) %>%
    left_join(bs %>% mutate(record_id = as.character(record_id)),
              by = "record_id", relationship = "many-to-one")
}

# Age group: completed years (floor) from unrounded age, so 18.9 stays in 15-18
add_age_group <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      age_int   = floor(age_exact),
      age_group = case_when(
        age_int <  5                 ~ "<5",
        age_int >= 5  & age_int < 15 ~ "5-14",
        age_int >= 15 & age_int < 19 ~ "15-18",
        age_int >= 19                ~ "19+",
        TRUE                         ~ "Missing"
      ),
      age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("<5", "5-14", "15-18", "19+", "Missing"))
    )
}

# Age group counts for one site (unique records, n + %)
age_table <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    distinct(record_id, age_group) %>%
    count(age_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(age_group = "Total", n = sum(.$n), pct = 100))
}
```

# 5. Build trigger datasets

```{r build}
mlw_comm_trig  <- make_comm_trigger(mlw_comm_raw) %>%
  add_age_group()

pgi_comm_trig  <- make_comm_trigger(pgi_comm_raw) %>%
  add_age_group()

mrcg_comm_trig <- make_comm_trigger(mrcg_comm_raw,
                                    baseline_event = "baseline_q0_arm_1") %>%
  add_age_group()
```

# 6. Checks

```{r checks-records}
# Trigger rows / unique records
nrow(mlw_comm_trig);  n_distinct(mlw_comm_trig$record_id)
nrow(pgi_comm_trig);  n_distinct(pgi_comm_trig$record_id)
nrow(mrcg_comm_trig); n_distinct(mrcg_comm_trig$record_id)

# Duplicated record_id in trigger datasets (if any)
mlw_comm_trig  %>% count(record_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
pgi_comm_trig  %>% count(record_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
mrcg_comm_trig %>% count(record_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
```

```{r checks-age}
# Age source (dob / calc / reported / NA = no age info)
table(mlw_comm_trig$age_source,  useNA = "ifany")
table(pgi_comm_trig$age_source,  useNA = "ifany")
table(mrcg_comm_trig$age_source, useNA = "ifany")

# Age distribution
summary(mlw_comm_trig$age_exact)
summary(pgi_comm_trig$age_exact)
summary(mrcg_comm_trig$age_exact)

# Implausible age (negative or > 100)
mlw_comm_trig  %>% filter(age_exact < 0 | age_exact > 100) %>% distinct(record_id, bs_dob, bs_ic_dt, age_years)
pgi_comm_trig  %>% filter(age_exact < 0 | age_exact > 100) %>% distinct(record_id, bs_dob, bs_ic_dt, age_years)
mrcg_comm_trig %>% filter(age_exact < 0 | age_exact > 100) %>% distinct(record_id, bs_dob, bs_ic_dt, age_years)

# MLW: DOB-based age vs REDCap-calculated age (should be ~0)
summary(mlw_comm_trig$age_dob - mlw_comm_trig$age_calc)
```

```{r checks-mrcg}
# MRCG: which age variables actually have values (by event)
mrcg_comm_raw %>%
  group_by(redcap_event_name) %>%
  summarise(across(any_of(c("bs_dob_known", "bs_dob", "bs_ic_dt", "bs_age_calc")),
                   ~ sum(!is.na(.x))))

# MRCG: trigger records with age info
mrcg_comm_trig %>%
  distinct(record_id, bs_dob_known, bs_dob, bs_ic_dt, bs_age_calc, age_years, age_source)
```

# 7. Age group summary

## 7.1 Per site

```{r age-per-site}
age_table(mlw_comm_trig)
age_table(pgi_comm_trig)
age_table(mrcg_comm_trig)
```

## 7.2 Combined (site x age group)

```{r age-combined}
# Keep only needed columns before combining
age_summary <- bind_rows(
  MLW  = mlw_comm_trig  %>% select(record_id, age_group),
  PGI  = pgi_comm_trig  %>% select(record_id, age_group),
  MRCG = mrcg_comm_trig %>% select(record_id, age_group),
  .id  = "site"
) %>%
  distinct(site, record_id, age_group) %>%
  count(site, age_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-site)))

age_summary <- age_summary %>%
  bind_rows(
    age_summary %>%
      summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
      mutate(site = "Total")
  ) %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = c("MLW", "PGI", "MRCG", "Total"))) %>%
  arrange(site)

age_summary

# n (%) version
age_summary_pct <- age_summary %>%
  mutate(across(c(`<5`, `5-14`, `15-18`, `19+`, Missing),
                ~ paste0(.x, " (", round(.x / Total * 100, 1), "%)")))

age_summary_pct
```

# 8. Save (optional)

```{r save, eval=FALSE}
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(age_n = age_summary, age_pct = age_summary_pct),
  paste0("SAVAC_comm_age_summary_", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx")
)
```
